name: watch
description: Lets Claude watch a video or a call recording: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, LinkedIn, X, local files, Zoom/Meet/Loom calls. Samples frames into contact sheets, transcribes speech locally (faster-whisper, no API key), labels speakers on calls, then Claude writes a structured breakdown: hook, timeline, on-screen text, CTA, or decisions and objections for calls.
